week.desc: Work-in-progress fork of VIctory: getting an Xbox Series title to render and run on a Windows PC. No game files.
features: - Meshlet culling read its scene buffers as the wrong kind of view, so the world drew almost nothing; fixed.
- Per-draw descriptor tables could run out, after which draws used slots never made for them and the card hung; fixed.
- Light packed by the game's compute shaders was read back through empty copies (sky, probes, fog); fixed for every mip level and layer.
- The fog reconstruction, shadow-mask, hair, blend-shape skinning, fire and several material programs did not translate; fixed.
- Gathers at a named mip level (with and without an offset) read level 0; fixed.
- Implicit-level samples outside pixel shaders produced invalid DXIL in 730 compute programs; fixed.
- Rectangle lists, depth and stencil twins for depth textures written by compute, texture read-backs.
- Waits for memory values, write-watch queries and page queries no longer walk page tables per call.
- Large title buffers get a copy in card memory, with shader writes found by hashing on the card.
- Title memory can be opened as a graphics heap so that buffers are used in place instead of copied (VICTORYINPLACE, first stage only; a probe confirmed the approach on the test GPU).
- The bindless texture queue no longer uploads stale views; the view table no longer grows without bound; the pipeline library is mapped instead of read into memory.
- An intermittent device loss was traced to the pipeline library file being replaced while mapped; fixed.
week.trDesc: VIctory 的正在进行中的分支：让 Xbox Series 游戏在 Windows PC 上渲染和运行。不包含游戏文件。
week.trFeat:
- 网格体剔除将场景缓冲区读取为错误的视图类型，因此世界几乎没有绘制任何内容；已修复。
- 每个绘制的描述符表可能会用完，此后绘制会使用并非为其创建的插槽，导致显卡挂起；已修复。
- 由游戏计算着色器打包的光源通过空副本（天空、探针、雾）读回；已针对每个 Mip 级别和图层修复。 - 雾效重建、阴影遮罩、头发、混合形状蒙皮、火焰和多个材质程序未转换；已修复。
- 在命名 Mip 级别（有偏移和无偏移）处聚集读取级别 0；已修复。
- 像素着色器之外的隐式级别采样在 730 个计算程序中产生了无效的 DXIL；已修复。
- 由计算写入的深度纹理的矩形列表、深度和模板孪生体，纹理回读。 - 等待内存值，写监视查询和页面查询不再在每次调用时遍历页表。
- 大型标题缓冲区在显卡内存中获得一个副本，通过在显卡上进行哈希来找到着色器写入。
- 标题内存可以作为图形堆打开，以便就地使用缓冲区，而不是进行复制（VICTORYINPLACE，仅限第一阶段；探查器在测试 GPU 上确认了该方法）。 - 无绑定纹理队列不再上传过时的视图；视图表不再无限制地增长；管线库被映射而不是被读入内存。
- 间歇性设备丢失被追溯到管道库文件在映射时被替换；已修复。

Mirror of Levent Alpöge's Lean proof of the Riemann Hypothesis (with Claude). All credit to Levent Alpöge. Source: alpo.ge
features: - RiemannHypothesis is Mathlib's own definition (Mathlib/NumberTheory/LSeries/RiemannZeta.lean, line 185 at the pinned commit), so the headline statement comes from Mathlib, outside this repository:
- src/Statements.lean (16 lines, imports only Mathlib) defines the other four statements:
- RiemannZetaZerosOnLine: every zero of riemannZeta other than the trivial zeros -2(n+1) and s = 1 has real part 1/2
- DirichletLNonvanishingRightOfHalf: for every Dirichlet character χ mod N, LFunction χ s ≠ 0 when Re s 1/2 (excluding χ = 1, s = 1)
- DirichletLZerosOnLine / PrimitiveDirichletLZerosOnLine: zeros of Dirichlet L-functions in the critical strip lie on Re s = 1/2 (GRH for Dirichlet L-functions)
- The proof terms come from src/Supplements/Kernels/MainTheorems.lean:
week.trDesc: Levent Alpöge 对黎曼猜想的精益证明的镜像（与 Claude 一起）。所有功劳归于Levent Alpöge。来源：alpo.ge
week.trFeat:
- RiemannHypothesis 是 Mathlib 自己的定义（Mathlib/NumberTheory/LSeries/RiemannZeta.lean，固定提交的第 185 行），因此标题命题来自 Mathlib，不在本代码仓库中：
- src/Statements.lean（16 行，仅导入 Mathlib）定义了另外四个命题：
- RiemannZetaZerosOnLine ： riemannZeta 的每个零点（平凡零点 -2(n+1) 和 s = 1 除外）的实部为 1/2 - DirichletLNonvanishingRightOfHalf：对于每个狄利克雷（Dirichlet）特征 χ mod N，当 Re s 1/2 时，LFunction χ s ≠ 0（不包括 χ = 1, s = 1）
- DirichletLZerosOnLine / PrimitiveDirichletLZerosOnLine：狄利克雷L函数的零点位于临界带的Re s = 1/2上（狄利克雷L函数的广义黎曼猜想）
